ticket: KAI-89 forensic data audit — transport/access/geography (phase 1, read-only)

fieldSemantics.conclusion: transportOptions is LEGACY STATIC per-mode travel-time metadata, conventionally 'door-to-door one-way minutes from Tokyo (default home station)' — but with documented inconsistency: some records carry local-access minutes (station→attraction), and island records carry ferry-leg minutes (mainland port→island).
evidence: scripts/repair-kansai-expansion-transport.ts header: 'Transport times are door-to-door minutes from Tokyo (default home station), consistent with the majority convention in destinations-index.json' and per-group derivations (e.g. 'Tokyo→Shin-Osaka(150)+Kuroshio to Wakayama(80)=230min base').

scripts/expand-major-city-catalog.ts createDestination(): children clone parent.transportOptions with jitter `Math.max(10, minutes + (id.length % 11) - 5)` → 195-205 clusters around train:200 (proven template generation).

scripts/fix-kanto-coordinates-and-transit.ts: recalculated Kanto train values as distance-based estimates from Tokyo/Yokohama Station (estimateBetween) → small 14-62 min clusters (estimator quantization).

src/shared/types/destination.ts: transportOptions type has NO doc comment (unlike totalTripHours which is marked @deprecated with 'Pre-KAI-50 imports used this with inconsistent semantics: sometimes on-site time, sometimes a whole trip from a fixed origin such as Tokyo/Yokohama').
MODE_SEMANTICS (qa/kai-12/MODE_SEMANTICS.md) defines mode meanings for the ORIGIN-AWARE registries; it does not govern static transportOptions.
fieldSemantics.separateFromOriginAware: YES. Origin-aware routing is a separate canonical system: TransportTopologyService (zone localModes/edges) + ground-routes.json + bus-routes.json + flight-estimates.json + ferry-estimates.json + ferry-routes.json. OriginAwareTransportService reads ONLY those registries; transportOptions is never an input to origin-aware estimates.
runtimeReads: src/features/destinations/DestinationDetails.tsx groundMinutesFor(): displays transportOptions[mode] as travel time when no homeStationCoords (neutral browsing); ignored when origin given.
src/features/destinations/Destinations.tsx travelTime sort: min(transportOptions) used only when no origin; 'never a legacy transportOptions fallback' with origin.
src/features/compare/Compare.tsx + CompareModal.tsx: min(transportOptions values) for comparison travel times.
src/shared/services/budget/BudgetService.ts getTransportCost (lines 517-578): `originAwareMinutes ?? dest.transportOptions?.[mode]` fallback for per-mode one-way minute heuristics.

src/shared/services/recommendation/RecommendationScorer.ts (153-179): transportOptions key presence = mode-authorization gate when no personalized origin; canonical-origin authoritative when origin exists.
src/features/qa/QaDashboard.tsx: counts records per mode key.

Semantic inconsistency: transportOptions mixes Tokyo-origin minutes (majority; repair-kansai header) with local-access minutes (horyuji-temple-nara train:45, Matsushima cluster train:40) and island ferry-leg minutes (yakushima ferry:240, miyajima ferry:10). No single documented convention in the type contract (destination.ts transportOptions has no doc comment).
teshima-island-kagawa ferry:180 (outside 61 clusters): real Takamatsu→Teshima ferry ~40-60 min; 180 questionable — manual review.
190 empty-transportOptions records: no static claim by design; product decision whether major hubs should carry neutral-browsing display values.
okinawa-main zone 'train' localMode (Yui Rail) makes validators blind to fabricated train VALUES (train:200 on naha-city passes ISLAND_RAIL_CLAIM/V-ISLAND-RAIL) — needs value-bound check.
The {train:200}/{train:180} template defaults remain the single largest source of misleading neutral-browsing travel times.

validators.desc: ≥3 records with identical transportOptions object — already implemented (data-quality-rules.ts collectTransportClusters); 61 clusters currently violate; recommend keeping as ERROR after data cleanup, or baselining.
rail claim in rail-less island zone — already implemented; currently 0 violations (KAI-87 cleaned).

okinawa-main zone records with transportOptions.train > 30 (Yui Rail max ~17 min end-to-end) — flags naha-city, kokusai-dori-naha, naminoue-shrine-naha, fukushuen-garden-naha (200), shuri-castle-okinawa (45).

transportOptions.train < transportOptions.shinkansen (ordering inverted for same-origin minutes) — currently ~19 records (pr12c Kyushu pairs: train:N, shinkansen:N+100/110). Deterministic; promote to ERROR after data fix.
train/bus > 400 min on non-island records, or train/bus > 300 on Hokkaido/Okinawa/Kyushu/Shikoku prefecture records — flags template defaults (200-400 range) without a plausible referent.
bus value present without a verified highway-bus corridor (MODE_SEMANTICS §3: local/limousine/shuttle buses never count) — all bus-claim records lack corridor rows; flags bus:210-400 fabrications.
